newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said his government had prepared a package of measures to ensure Romania's macro-economic stability.
* Ciorbea presented leaders of the National Peaseant Party data on Romania's economic situation and announced steps to halt the decline of the country's economy.
